faq_heading: Price Reduced Homes for Sale in Chilliwack: your questions answered

faq.q: How much below asking are Chilliwack homes selling for?
faq.a: From November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, Chilliwack houses closed at a median 97.2% of the last list price, townhomes at 97.3% and condos at 96.7%.

faq.q: How long do Chilliwack houses take to sell?
faq.a: The median was 26 days for houses, 29 for townhomes and 36 for condos, for sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How many Chilliwack houses sell above the list price?
faq.a: 5% of Chilliwack houses sold above their last list price from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, against 1% of townhomes and 5% of condos.

blocks.text: This search lists Chilliwack homes where the asking price has dropped by at least 1%, pulled live from the MLS®. Land and income properties are left out; houses, townhomes and condos are all included. To read a cut, compare it with what Chilliwack homes actually sell for. From November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, 294 Chilliwack houses sold at a median $825,000 after 26 days, and they closed at 97.2% of the last list price, with 5% selling above it.
What a price drop means in Chilliwack

Chilliwack homes have been closing close to their last list price: houses 97.2%, townhomes 97.3%, condos 96.7%, duplexes 98.4%, manufactured homes 97.6% of it. So the gap between asking and selling is small, about 2.8 percentage points for houses, and a listing that has already dropped is competing with sales that closed within a few percent of the price they last carried. A cut of more than that is a sign the first price was out of line, and it is worth asking what happened between the first price and the current one.
